claim_boundary: C011 attacks exact-certificate descendants and inherited theta routes; no attack is marked decisive.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a singular PSD matrix may defeat rational LDL elimination
attacks.method: Use diagonal pivoting and verify that a remaining zero diagonal block must be the zero matrix for PSD input.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the constructor may certify an indefinite rational matrix
attacks.method: Test negative Schur diagonals and zero-diagonal blocks with nonzero off-diagonal entries.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a rational PSD matrix may require irrational square roots
attacks.method: Replace ordinary Gram factors by rational L,D factors and reconstruct exactly without square roots.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exact elimination may have superpolynomial intermediate bit length
attacks.method: Reduce entries to ratios of minors; a publication-quality bound is not yet independently reviewed.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the edge basis may introduce a factor-of-two error
attacks.method: Fix A_e with ones in both symmetric positions and derive the weak-duality identity under X_ij=0.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the verifier may return a wrong theta value on elementary graphs
attacks.method: Verify K2 has theta 1 and the two-vertex empty graph has theta 2 with exact certificates.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: feasible primal and dual objects with unequal values may be accepted as exact
attacks.method: Mutate a valid dual objective and require rejection.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: not every theta optimum is rational
attacks.method: Limit H093 to supplied rational primal-dual pairs rather than claiming universal rational attainment.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: theta below the clause target may not imply UNSAT
attacks.method: Check alpha(G)<=theta(G)<=t<m and SAT iff alpha(G)=m for the standard conflict graph.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a valid certificate may be attached to the wrong CNF
attacks.method: Require future bundles to bind graph and formula hashes; the current generic verifier does not yet perform that binding.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: failure to find a gap may be misreported as SAT
attacks.method: State and test only the implication t<m => UNSAT.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a zero-vertex conflict graph has no trace-one primal
attacks.method: Keep H094 dual-only and require a positive graph vertex count in the current certificate format; empty-clause formulas need a separate trivial UNSAT path.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: copying CNFs may create complementary literals across components
attacks.method: Offset every component variable range and check the combined conflict graph has exactly the sum of component edges.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the SAT label may not amplify under disjoint union
attacks.method: Compute exact alpha on tiny fixtures and compare with the component sum.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the chosen SDP convention may not preserve the expected direct-sum identity
attacks.method: Require a written primal and dual construction under the exact H093 normalization.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: amplification may hide a nonuniform family description
attacks.method: Use r renamed copies generated in time polynomial in r and seed size.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the laboratory may mistake a rejected pair for a collision
attacks.method: The self-test verifies SAT and UNSAT components separately and requires the unequal-theta pair to be rejected.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a collision may exist only at an irrational theta value
attacks.method: Keep H096 narrower than H087 by explicitly requiring exact rational certificates.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a graph collision may not arise from clause-literal conflict graphs
attacks.method: Require every component bundle to use the registered conflict-graph target and exact alpha diagnostic.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: failure on small instances may be misread as a universal refutation
attacks.method: Declare finite exhaustion nondecisive unless paired with a structural theorem covering all sizes.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: rational approximation may fail near the PSD boundary
attacks.method: Require explicit inverse-polynomial primal and dual Slater margins.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: rounding may consume the entire objective gap
attacks.method: Require an independent inverse-polynomial objective separation margin and reserve a fixed fraction for perturbation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: matrix dimension may make rational denominators exponential
attacks.method: Charge dimension and log inverse margins explicitly; the final approximation theorem remains open.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a nearby rational PSD slack may still have a huge LDL representation
attacks.method: Reduce the question to H092 fraction bounds plus a rational perturbation preserving strict PSD.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H070 may demand exact theta when only an upper gap is needed
attacks.method: Extract H094; H070 remains blocked on constructing a gap for every UNSAT formula.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: ordinary rational Gram factors may not exist for every rational PSD matrix
attacks.method: Replace them with rational LDL certificates in H092; short-certificate existence remains open.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: symmetry transport may preserve PSD but destroy a compact certificate
attacks.method: Transport the matrix and reconstruct an LDL certificate; polynomial bit accounting still depends on H092.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: functional pullback may preserve polynomial nonnegativity but not a compact matrix certificate
attacks.method: Separate semantic pullback from subsequent rational LDL reconstruction.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the infinite-family formulation obscures the smallest decisive witness
attacks.method: Split finite exact collision H096 from amplification H095.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: ordinary rational Gram factors require rational square roots and may omit rational PSD matrices
attacks.method: Introduce H092 LDL certificates while retaining H089 as a conditional verifier for supplied ordinary factors.
